openingBriefing.title: Good Morning! Today's Workout: 6km Zone 2 Easy Aerobic Run
openingBriefing.summaryText: Welcome to your morning run! Today's session is 6 kilometers. Target pace is 7:20 - 7:35 min/km with an RPE of 3 out of 10. Morning temperature is 21°C with 90% humidity. High sweat rate expected—take your scheduled salt capsules on time.
openingBriefing.weatherAdvisory: Morning temperature is 21°C with 90% humidity. High sweat rate expected—take your scheduled salt capsules on time.

timeline.title: 🚀 Workout Started
timeline.text: Starting workout. Conversational aerobic endurance building. Settle into an easy rhythm.

timeline.title: 📍 Kilometer 1 Split
timeline.text: Kilometer 1 reached. Gently float into your rhythm. Do not start too fast.

timeline.title: 📍 Kilometer 5 Split
timeline.text: Kilometer 5 reached. 5k completed. Check your posture and relax your neck.

timeline.title: 💧 Fueling & Electrolyte Alert (45 Min Mark)
timeline.text: 45 minutes elapsed. Take 1 Salt Capsule now with 150 ml water to protect your calves from cramping.

timeline.title: 🏆 Workout Complete!
timeline.text: Workout complete! Fantastic work on today's 6km session. Take 500ml electrolyte water and perform your calf armor heel drops.
